features.name: Create a new canvas
steps: Open "new"
Choose one of the presets such as current size, fit to page, large canvas, square, landscape size, or portrait size
The canvas width and height can also be filled in directly
Switch between white, black, and transparent backgrounds
Create a new canvas
The new canvas size and background match the settings
features.expected: The new canvas's size and background must match the selected settings; the preset and custom width/height are applied correctly.

features.name: Basic brush drawing
steps: Select the normal brush
Set parameters such as the brush size, opacity, and scatter
Draw by dragging continuously on the canvas
Continue drawing after changing the color
New strokes use the new color and parameters while existing content stays unchanged
features.expected: The brush size/opacity/scatter parameters must take effect; after changing the color new strokes use the new parameters while existing content stays unchanged.

features.name: Multiple brush modes
steps: Switch between different brush types at the top of the brush tool
Adjust the brush size, opacity, smudge, grid length, pressure/scatter, and other parameters that brush supports
Draw on the same canvas
Different brushes produce clearly different textures or stroke effects
features.expected: Different brush types must produce clearly different textures or stroke effects; each brush's parameters take effect independently.

features.name: Brush locking and auxiliary parameters
steps: Enter a brush that supports locking
Set the brush size and opacity
Enable or disable options such as "lock"
Draw several strokes
The tool state and corresponding parameters are preserved within the current brush session
features.expected: The state of options such as locking must be preserved within the current brush session; the tool state stays consistent after drawing several strokes.

features.name: Eraser
steps: First create existing strokes on the canvas
Switch to the eraser
Set the eraser size and opacity
Drag on top of existing content
The corresponding area is erased or its opacity lowered while unpassed areas stay unchanged
features.expected: The eraser must only affect the passed area (erasing or lowering opacity); unpassed areas stay unchanged.

features.name: Color selection
steps: Open the color panel
Choose the lightness and saturation in the 2D color area
Switch the hue on the hue bar
Continue brushing or filling with the current color
Newly drawn content uses the selected color
features.expected: The color selection (lightness/saturation/hue) must take effect; newly drawn content uses the selected color.

features.name: Eyedropper color picking
steps: Several colors already exist on the canvas
Use the eyedropper tool
Tap a color already in the image
The current foreground color updates to the sampled color
Then use the brush or fill to verify the color has changed
features.expected: The eyedropper must pick the real color at the tapped position; after the foreground color updates, the brush/fill verifies consistently.

features.name: Fill tool
steps: Switch to the paint bucket/fill tool
Choose the color
Set parameters such as opacity, tolerance, sampling mode, fill expansion, and contiguous
Tap the target area
Only the connected region matching the conditions is filled
features.expected: The fill only affects the qualifying connected region; the tolerance/expansion/contiguous parameters genuinely affect the result.

features.name: Advanced fill-tool states
steps: Toggle options such as "contiguous", sampling range, and eraser in the fill tool
Fill different areas of the same image
Compare the affected areas under different parameters
Parameter changes should genuinely affect the fill result
features.expected: Different parameters (contiguous / sampling range / eraser) must produce comparable yet different fill results.

features.name: Pan and zoom the canvas
steps: Switch to the hand tool
Drag the canvas to pan
Change the view scale with the zoom-in and zoom-out controls
Use fit/reset view to restore the viewport
The image content itself is not modified
features.expected: Panning and zooming only change the view; the image content itself is not modified; resetting the view restores it correctly.

features.name: Canvas view rotation
steps: Enter the hand/view tool
Adjust the canvas rotation angle or use the rotation control
The canvas view orientation changes
Resetting returns to the default orientation
The image pixels themselves are not permanently changed by rotating the view
features.expected: Rotating the view only changes the display orientation; resetting restores the default; the image pixels are not permanently changed.

features.name: Undo and redo
steps: Perform drawing, filling, or transformation operations in succession
Tap undo to step back
Then tap redo to restore it
Step forward and back through the operation history in the correct order
features.expected: Undo must step back through the history in reverse; redo restores correctly; the order is correct.

features.name: Create a new layer
steps: Enter the layer panel
Add a layer
Draw content on the new layer
The layer list shows at least two independent layers
The original content below is not directly modified
features.expected: The new layer must be independently drawable; at least two layers coexist; the lower layer's original content is not directly modified.

features.name: Duplicate layer
steps: Create a layer with content
Tap duplicate layer
Produce a new layer named with "copy"
Hide either one of them
It can be confirmed that the two layers' contents are independent
features.expected: Duplicating a layer must produce an independent copy (named with "copy"); hiding either layer confirms their independence.

features.name: Delete and clear layers
steps: Create several layers
Select a layer
Test deleting a layer and Clear layer separately
On delete the layer entry disappears; on clear the layer still exists but the pixel content is cleared
features.expected: After deleting a layer the entry disappears; after clearing the layer the entry remains but the pixels are cleared; the two behaviors are distinguishable.

features.name: Layer visibility
steps: Create two or more layers
Tap the visibility toggle in front of the layer
The corresponding layer is hidden from the composite
Open it again
The content is restored and displayed
features.expected: The visibility toggle must genuinely hide/show the corresponding layer; other layers are unaffected.

features.name: Layer opacity
steps: Select a layer with content
Adjust the layer-opacity slider
Observe the blend strength between that layer and the one below in real time
The other layers' opacity stays unchanged
features.expected: The layer opacity must change the blend strength in real time; other layers' opacity stays unchanged.

features.name: Layer blend mode
steps: Create upper and lower layers containing content of different colors
Open the blend-mode dropdown
Switch from "Normal" to another available mode
The composited image changes with the mode
When switching back to normal the ordinary overlay effect is restored
features.expected: Switching the blend mode must change the composite; switching back to normal restores the ordinary overlay.

features.name: Layer order
steps: Create several distinguishable layers
Change the stacking with the move-layer-up/down or related ordering buttons
The occlusion relationship changes in sync
The layer-list order matches the final composite order
features.expected: After moving up/down the occlusion relationship must match the list order.

features.name: Merge layers
steps: Create at least two layers with content
Use the merge/merge-all features
The layer count decreases
The merged visual result is essentially consistent with the pre-merge combined state
features.expected: After merging the layer count decreases; the merged result is essentially visually consistent with the pre-merge combination.

features.name: Select the area
steps: Enter the selection tool
Switch between selection modes such as rectangle, ellipse, and free-form
Create a selection on the canvas
The selection boundary is displayed correctly
The selection disappears after reset/deselect
features.expected: The selection modes (rectangle / ellipse / free) must create selections correctly; the boundary displays correctly; it disappears after cancelling.

features.name: Invert the selection, select all, and reset
steps: Create a local selection
Use operations such as "All", "Invert/Invert selection", and "Reset"
The selection range changes accordingly
Subsequent filling or erasing only affects the current selection
features.expected: All / invert / reset must correctly change the selection range; subsequent operations only affect the current selection.

features.name: Selection erasing and filling
steps: Create a local selection
Use "Erase" or "Fill"
Only the selected area is modified
Pixels outside the selection stay unchanged
features.expected: Erase/fill only modifies the selected area; pixels outside the selection stay unchanged.

features.name: Selection transformation
steps: Create a selection
Tap "transform"
Drag the boundary control points to scale
Rotate with the rotation control at the top
Apply the transformation
Only the selected content changes position, scale, or angle
features.expected: The transformation only changes the selected content's position/scale/angle; the rest stays unchanged.

features.name: Quick selection transformations
steps: Create a selection
Enter the transformation
Use the quick buttons for copy, flip X, flip Y, -90°, +90°, 2×, 1/2×, center, etc.
The preview changes
After applying, the result matches the selected operation
features.expected: The results of the quick transformation buttons must match the selected operation; the preview is correct.

features.name: Warp / deforming a selection
steps: Create a selection
Enter the transformation
Enable Warp
Adjust the selection's geometry
Helper options such as keep/align can still be toggled
Applying produces a non-rigid transformation effect
features.expected: Warp must produce a non-rigid transformation effect; the keep/align options can be toggled and take effect.

features.name: Move the transformed content to a layer
steps: Create a selection and enter the transformation
Use the "move to layer" target option
Output the transformation result to the specified layer
The content states of the source and target layers change correctly according to the option
features.expected: The transformation result must be output to the specified layer; the source and target layers' states change correctly according to the option.

features.name: Import an image
steps: Choose an image via the open/import entry
Preview the image in the "import image" window
Zoom or pan the preview
Choose "as layer" or "as image"
After importing, the image appears on the canvas or in a new layer
features.expected: The imported image must preview correctly; the "as layer / as image" modes give correct results.

features.name: The image is overlaid as a new layer
steps: The current canvas already has background content
Import a second image and choose "as layer"
An image layer is added to the layer list
The original background is still preserved
The new image layer can be adjusted independently
features.expected: The imported image must be overlaid as a new layer; the original background is preserved; the new layer can be adjusted independently.

features.name: Canvas size
steps: Open "canvas size"
Modify the left, right, top, and bottom expansion amounts separately
Use the rule of thirds to assist positioning
Set the fill color or transparency for the newly expanded area
After confirming, the canvas size changes with the existing content's positions correct
features.expected: The canvas expansion amounts (left/right/top/bottom) are applied correctly; the existing content's positions are correct; the expanded area is filled according to the settings.

features.name: Image size
steps: Open "image size"
Change the width or height
Enable "keep aspect ratio"
When changing one dimension the other links automatically
After applying, the whole image is scaled to the target size
features.expected: When changing one dimension it must link while preserving the aspect ratio; after applying, the whole image is scaled to the target size.

features.name: Horizontal/vertical flip
steps: Open the flip feature
Flip the whole image horizontally or vertically
Compare the orientation before and after applying
Performing the opposite operation again gives the corresponding mirrored result
features.expected: Horizontal/vertical flip directions are correct; performing the opposite operation again gives the mirrored restoration.

features.name: Rotate the image
steps: Open rotate
Rotate 90° left or 90° right
Preview the rotated image
Apply
The canvas image orientation changes with the content kept complete
features.expected: After rotating 90° the image orientation changes and the content is complete.

features.name: Free-transform the whole image
steps: Open free transform
Set X, Y, and the rotation angle
Use options such as flip X/Y, ±90°, 2×, 1/2×, center, and copy
Check the result in the preview
After applying, the whole-image transformation takes effect
features.expected: The free transform (X/Y/rotate/flip/scale/center/copy) results match the settings.

features.name: Perspective transformation
steps: Open "perspective"
Switch between the "before/after" previews
Drag the corner control points to change the perspective
Confirm
The image undergoes perspective correction or trapezoidal deformation
features.expected: The perspective transformation must produce perspective correction or trapezoidal deformation; dragging the four corner control points takes effect; the preview toggling is correct.

features.name: Brightness/contrast
steps: Open brightness/contrast
Adjust the brightness and contrast values
The preview updates in real time
After confirming, the effect is written into the image
Cancelling does not change the original image
features.expected: Brightness/contrast adjustments preview in real time; confirming writes them; cancelling does not change the original image.

features.name: Curve adjustment
steps: Open "curves"
Switch between the all, red, green, and blue channels
Add or move curve control points
Observe the color and brightness changes in the preview
Apply the curves after confirming
features.expected: The curves (RGB channel switching, control points) must be reflected in the preview in real time; they are applied after confirming.

features.name: Hue/saturation
steps: Open "hue/saturation"
Adjust the hue and saturation parameters
View the live preview
After confirming, the whole image's colors change accordingly
features.expected: The hue/saturation adjustments preview in real time; after confirming the whole image's colors change accordingly.

features.name: Invert
steps: Invert the current layer or image
The colors are converted to the complementary effect
Undo restores the image from before the application
features.expected: Invert must convert to complementary colors; undo restores the original image.

features.name: Blur
steps: Open "blur"
Adjust the radius
Observe the detail gradually softening
Confirm
The image is blurred by the specified radius
features.expected: The blur radius must genuinely affect the softening degree; the processing is completed by radius after confirming.

features.name: USM sharpening
steps: Open "USM sharpening"
Adjust the radius and strength
Compare the edge detail in the preview
After confirming, the sharpening is applied to the current image
features.expected: The USM sharpening radius and strength must affect edge detail; it is applied after confirming.

features.name: Displacement / Shift effect
steps: Open the tilt-shift/displacement filter
Adjust the gradient radius and blur radius
Move the two control points to change the effect center or direction
After applying, a local part of the image stays sharp with a corresponding blur transition around it
features.expected: The displacement / tilt-shift effect (gradient radius / blur radius / control point) must produce local sharpness and transitional blur.

features.name: Distortion filter
steps: Open "distort"
Choose different distortion modes
Set the pattern size X/Y, strength X/Y, phase X/Y, step, and sync XY
The preview produces periodic ripples or twisting
Apply after confirming
features.expected: The distortion filter's parameters (pattern size / strength / phase / step) must produce periodic ripples or twisting.

features.name: Grid effect
steps: Open "grid"
Set the X/Y division counts, line width, and line color
Preview the generated grid overlay
After applying, the grid becomes part of the image effect
features.expected: The grid divisions/line width/color must take effect; after applying they become part of the image effect.

features.name: Noise effect
steps: Open "noise"
Choose the noise texture
Set the pattern size and opacity
Switch between RGB and Alpha
Change the inverse, blend mode, and color
After applying, the corresponding noise effect is produced
features.expected: The noise texture/size/opacity/RGB-Alpha/inverse/blend mode must combine and take effect correctly.

features.name: Pattern effect
steps: Open "pattern"
Set X, Y, width, height, and smudge
Compare between before/after
Adjust the sampling area and preview the repeating tiled pattern
Apply after confirming
features.expected: The pattern parameters (X/Y/width & height/smudge) and the sampling area must affect the tiled preview; they are applied after confirming.

features.name: Vanishing-point effect
steps: Open "vanishing point"
Adjust the line count, vanishing-point X/Y, line width, and color
Preview the radial perspective lines
After confirming, the corresponding vanishing-point guide effect is generated on the image
features.expected: The vanishing-point parameters (line count / vanishing-point position / line width / color) must generate the corresponding radial perspective lines.

features.name: Text tool
steps: Switch to the text tool
Tap the target position on the canvas
Enter text
Complete the text insertion
The text result is displayed on the canvas and can take part in later image editing
features.expected: The text must be inserted at the tapped position; the content displays correctly and can take part in later editing.

features.name: Browser local save
steps: Switch to "Files"
Save the current artwork in the "save to browser" area
Refresh or re-enter the page
Open from the browser's saved records
Restore the artwork content from the saved state
features.expected: After saving to the browser, refreshing/re-entering restores the saved artwork content.

features.name: Overwrite the browser saved record
steps: A browser-saved copy already exists
Modify the canvas content
Tap "overwrite"
Open that record again
Load the latest overlaid version rather than an old one
features.expected: After overwriting, reopening must load the latest version rather than the old one.

features.name: Delete the browser saved record
steps: Save the artwork to the browser
Choose "clear" in the file panel
The corresponding thumbnail record disappears
The canvas currently being edited should not be lost immediately because a saved record is deleted
features.expected: After clearing, the thumbnail record disappears; the canvas currently being edited is not immediately lost because a saved record is deleted.

features.name: Recover closed tabs
steps: Produce a recoverable closed-item state
Use "Recover closed tabs"
The most recently closed canvas reappears in the editor
The image content and basic editing state are restored
features.expected: Recover closed tabs must restore the most recently closed canvas content and the basic editing state.

features.name: File save / export
steps: Enter the file panel
Open the save-format dropdown
Choose a supported format such as PNG
Save
The browser generates the corresponding image file
The output image is visually consistent with the current canvas content
features.expected: The export format (PNG, etc.) produces a correct file; the output image is visually consistent with the current canvas.

features.name: Complete editing workflow
steps: Create a canvas of the specified size
Draw the background with several brushes
Add a layer
Import an image as an independent layer
Adjust the layer order and opacity
Create a selection on a local area and transform it freely
Use brightness/contrast or curves
Save to the browser
Open it again to confirm the state
Finally export the PNG
features.expected: The complete workflow (new / multiple brushes / layers / import / selection transform / color adjustment / save / export) is correct at every step; the final export succeeds.

exclusions.feature: Uploading to a third-party server / "upload" online hosting
exclusions.reason: Kleki's core editing capability does not depend on the cloud; there is no need to build an image-hosting server for the reproduction. The button can be kept disabled or simply not implemented.

exclusions.feature: Online sharing / generating a public share link
exclusions.reason: It involves external hosting, link generation, and long-term resource availability and is not part of the core local drawing and image-editing flow. Excluding the actual public sharing backend is recommended.

If the original site's share button calls the system Share API or external social platforms, the specific third-party integration need not be reproduced; at most a copy-file/local-share entry is kept.

exclusions.feature: Performance parity on extremely high-resolution, large images
exclusions.reason: Full parity with the original site in performance, memory usage, and processing speed at tens of millions of pixels and huge layer counts is not required; correct operation at normal desktop image sizes is enough.

exclusions.feature: Pixel-perfect parity of each filter with the original Kleki
exclusions.reason: Brightness/contrast, curves, blur, USM, noise, pattern, warp, and vanishing point need the features and interactions to exist with effects in the correct direction, but the algorithm output is not required to be pixel-identical to the original site.

exclusions.feature: The browser/OS native file-picker and download-dialog UI
exclusions.reason: Only the standard file-open and download capabilities need to be invoked; replicating the appearance of Chrome's, Windows', or macOS' own file picker or save dialog is not required.
